relationships.subject: bioactive compounds
relationships.evidence_quote: Bioactive compounds such as Paeonol, Kaempferol, and Acteoside demonstrate significant analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting pro-inflammatory mediators (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6)

key_findings: Review: plant-derived bioactives are multi-target regulators that suppress pro-inflammatory cytokines and shift microglia from M1 to M2 in neuropathic pain.
